name: Dock
summary: A row of app shortcuts at the block end of the screen: Desk's glass dock with a magnify effect, a plain row of icon tiles in other styles.
useWhen: A desktop style shell with a set of apps the person opens and switches between
App shortcuts that show which apps are open
A launcher row of up to about a dozen destinations with strong icons
avoidWhen: Commands that act on the current content
Destinations whose icons do not say what they are

aria-label.description: Dock: required unless aria-labelledby is set. Names the landmark: Apps.

size.description: Dock: md tiles are size.control.lg (44px); lg tiles are 1.25 times that, for a desktop home screen.

label.description: DockItem: the app name. It is the link text, drawn above the tile on hover and focus; never only a native title.

icon.description: DockItem: a system icon name drawn in a tile, or a node such as an app image (decorative, empty alt).

href.description: DockItem: the app's route. An app that opens a window still has one (a route or a hash) and handles onClick.

active.description: DockItem: the current page belongs to this app. aria-current page, data-active and a ring on the tile.

open.description: DockItem: the app has an open window. data-open, the dot under the tile, and the word open in the name.

openLabel.description: DockItem: the words the open state adds to the name: Files, open. Arabic: مفتوح.

asChild.description: DockItem: renders its one child element (a router link) as the item.

a11y.role: navigation (the nav landmark) with a name; each item is a link, the current app's with aria-current page. Separators are decorative.
a11y.focus: Every item is a tab stop, in reading order. Focus shows the ring on the tile and draws the name.

keys.Enter: Follows the link, or runs the item's onClick

a11y.announce: Each link reads the app name, open when the app is open, and current page for the current app.
notes: The name is always the link text (WCAG 2.4.4, 4.1.2). It is drawn on hover and focus with opacity, so it is read at all times; no native title attribute.
Open is shown by the dot and said in the name; current is shown by a ring on the tile and aria-current, never by color alone.
Magnify (Desk) scales the tile with transform only and is off under reduced motion; the name still appears.
A fixed dock covers content unless the page keeps the same room at its block end (WCAG 2.4.11): the layout (PageShell) reserves it.
Many apps wrap onto a second row rather than scroll the page sideways (WCAG 1.4.10).
Every item is a link. The order allows buttons; a system Button would own the item's parts, so an app that opens a window keeps an href and handles onClick.

en.label: The app name, a noun, sentence case: Files, Mail, Calendar.

ar.label: Noun form labels, white Saudi dialect, no diacritics: الملفات، البريد، التقويم.

react.note: The name fades in on hover and focus (opacity); Desk magnifies the tile with a transform. Both collapse under reduced motion.

native.note: A desktop shell part. Phone layouts use TabBar.

styles.studio: A plain row: a surface-2 bar with a subtle hairline, overlay-10 tiles, no magnify.
styles.desk: Glass: the dock material with the glass blur, the window radius and soft window shadow, larger tile corners, and magnify: the tile under the pointer or focus grows 1.25 times and lifts, its neighbors 1.1 times. Solid under reduced transparency and more contrast; no magnify under reduced motion.
styles.neutral: Token driven; applies once the Neutral pack is merged.

mistakes.wrong: An app name only in a native title on hover
mistakes.right: label: the link text, drawn on hover and focus

mistakes.wrong: Open apps shown only by a brighter icon
mistakes.right: open: the dot, and the word open in the name

mistakes.wrong: A fixed dock over the last line of the page
mistakes.right: Reserve the dock's height at the end of the page

mistakes.wrong: Commands in the dock: Save, Share
